name: io.github.itsdimabro/bloom-growth-mcp
title: Bloom Growth
description: Unofficial MCP server for Bloom Growth. Every tool comes from Bloom Growth's own API description.

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_GROWTH_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email of the Bloom Growth user the server signs in as

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_GROWTH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: The password of that Bloom Growth user

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_GROWTH_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also list the tools that create, update and delete

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_GROWTH_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: A comma list of toolsets to list, such as todos,rocks,scorecard
